quotes.quote: The interactive exhibits were well worth our long trip from Illinois!
quotes.author: Kendra J.

quotes.quote: What a fabulous building, sloping into the wonderful  prairie!
quotes.author: Brenda S.

quotes.quote: The ability to herd cows, develop a brand and shoot a rifle as a ranch experience was creative and fun.
quotes.author: MHall

quotes.quote: The architecture is the first exhibit. Snøhetta set the 96,000-square-foot building into the hill, capped it with a walkable roof of native prairie grass, and used rammed-earth walls that read like Badlands layers.
quotes.author: Jane B.

quotes.quote: The interactive features like putting yourself in history, playing a cattle herding game or a shooting game were fun for the whole family, plus we learned about the life of Teddy Roosevelt.
quotes.author: Mandy B.

quotes.quote: Amazing place with state of the art features adding an element of fun to learning about history.
quotes.author: Nita W.

quotes.quote: I enjoyed the sensory, interactive displays. Getting to talk to TR was fun, I was asking about conservation.
quotes.author: Verlee G.

quotes.quote: The library is very interactive and people got a kick out of some of the AI use for putting yourself in Teddy’s time.
quotes.author: Chip K.

quotes.quote: The highlight for most people are the AI images that place you in a period photo as a Rough Rider, presidential candidate, and more.
quotes.author: Josh J.

quotes.quote: Amazing architecture the way it blends in and mimics the badlands it is situated in.
quotes.author: trip4four

quotes.quote: Beautiful building with sweeping views and a nice boardwalk walking trail and a walkable roof.
quotes.author: Troy S.

quotes.quote: The building is interesting in its own right & offers great views of the badlands.
quotes.author: Patrick

quotes.quote: Amazing amount of information and presented in such an engaging way. Spent the whole day there.
quotes.author: Sandy T.

quotes.quote: What a beautiful place to learn about TR and what he did for our nation.
quotes.author: Daniel A.

quotes.quote: Very well laid out, many historical items, films and lots of interactive displays.
quotes.author: Elizabeth L.

quotes.quote: We kicked our day off with a guided highlights tour pre-booked. It was a perfect lay of the landscape overview for the intensive, immersive Museum experience.
quotes.author: IowaTraveler925

quotes.quote: The views on the outside were great, and the exhibits on the inside were fun, interactive and very informative.
quotes.author: lynne S.

quotes.quote: Interactive state of the art museum. Appropriate for all ages.
quotes.author: Nancy B.

quotes.quote: No expense was spared building a library that attributes to one of our country's greatest presidents and an American heritage figure.
quotes.author: K. E.

quotes.quote: We were able to sit in the Oval Office and ask President Roosevelt questions.
quotes.author: LauraWfromMS

quotes.quote: The outside of the library is unlike anything I have seen before. The roof is completely covered with landscape.
quotes.author: Michelle R.

quotes.quote: Countless displays to read and see. We spent 4 hours and could have spent more and if you like history it’s a fantastic experience.
quotes.author: J U.

quotes.quote: The outdoor boardwalk and roof offer stunning panoramic views of the surrounding badlands, with plenty of seating and even porch swings to relax and enjoy the views.
quotes.author: Chris A.

quotes.quote: President's life presented in a visual format that could be understood by any age.
quotes.author: Dwight S.

quotes.quote: As someone who has read a bit about Theodore Roosevelt‘s life, this museum creates an immersive experience, mixing artifacts from his life to AI that brings life to what otherwise could be just another museum experience.
quotes.author: Jim

quotes.quote: Beautiful place that has been very thoughtful created. Engaging for every age group and inclusive.
quotes.author: Lauren S.

quotes.quote: We have gone twice now and we have a different experience each time. There is so much to see and explore.
quotes.author: Sarah T.

quotes.quote: I found it especially interesting to speak directly to Theodore Roosevelt in his office as an AI and I did ask him several questions.
quotes.author: Lori B.

quotes.quote: Everyone now has a reason to visit North Dakota, one of the best of the many I have visited.
quotes.author: RICHARD T.

quotes.quote: The live rooftop offers and nice walking trail with views of the beautiful surrounding terrain.
quotes.author: Amy B.

quotes.quote: You will also get to ask Teddy live questions and he answers…. Just unbelievable!
quotes.author: gramma M.

quotes.quote: Fantastic museum. The way it's laid out is the best and you can actually touch things.
quotes.author: Kelly R.

quotes.quote: You get to talk to an AI Teddy Roosevelt, ask him questions, and then he will answer you.
quotes.author: Charlotte T.

quotes.quote: Be sure and take the walk on the boardwalk outside and visit the roof.
quotes.author: Kevin C.

quotes.quote: We especially loved seeing Teddy's authentic diary on display in a carefully lit room -- opened to the page where he wrote a huge X after the death of his mother and beloved wife on the same day.
quotes.author: Melinda G.

quotes.quote: I'm particularly impressed by the seamless and innovative use of technology.
quotes.author: Mark M.

quotes.quote: The flow of it and how it was broken down by each decade of his presidential journey was truly spectacular.
quotes.author: Sarah

quotes.quote: Many replicas are not displayed under glass  so you can touch them.
quotes.author: panpanda

quotes.quote: Wow, this is really well done and surpassed my expectations.
quotes.author: Traci

quotes.quote: He was a great man and they did a great job telling the story of his life.
quotes.author: Russell W.

quotes.quote: The interactive photo opportunities make this an over the top experience for all ages
quotes.author: Terri M.

quotes.quote: They did a wonderful job making an interesting museum and library.
quotes.author: Mark S.

quotes.quote: There were things to do and see for all ages. Museum artifacts, interactive exhibits, scavenger hunts, replicas, rooms designed to immerse you in different eras of TR's life... there was just so much.
quotes.author: Lakeisha H.

quotes.quote: Interactive exhibit, very informative and the interactive exhibits were a fun highlight
quotes.author: Sharon F.

quotes.quote: Totally loved the location, the design, use of AI, and the interactive exhibits.
quotes.author: Brian H.

quotes.quote: Beautiful views from the roof and cool looking architecture.
quotes.author: Scott R.

quotes.quote: Great used of historical artifacts and technology to tell the history of this great US president.
quotes.author: William H.

quotes.quote: An exceptionally interactive and immersive educational experience housed in architecture that mirrors the surrounding beautiful landscape.
quotes.author: Annika G.

quotes.quote: It is an inspiring place for its architecture and high tech show.
quotes.author: Giorgio F.

quotes.quote: Recently opened on July 4 this year it is a beautiful display of architecture that meets nature and its surrounding area.
quotes.author: Gayle B.

quotes.quote: Interactive displays get people of all ages and abilities involved.
quotes.author: Betty B.

quotes.quote: The exhibits were so interactive and so much fun. The curators remembered that adults like to play and have fun too:).
quotes.author: Richard D.

quotes.quote: The exhibits were informative and hands on.  The library is very interactive with fun AI engagement.  There is lots to explore so allow at least 3 hours there.
quotes.author: Sleepyscags

quotes.quote: The really cool mini-theaters detailing TR's Rough Riders and Brazilian river expedition.
quotes.author: Vish B.

quotes.quote: The building itself is absolutely beautiful, and it's worth to to learn also about the ways the library is generating its own sustainable energy, curbs carbon, loses no water, and aims for zero waste.
quotes.author: M-A

quotes.quote: The rooftop and boardwalk offer stunning views and the building is innovative.
quotes.author: Pam

quotes.quote: You get a good sense of the place and what it must have felt like to live here more than a century ago.
quotes.author: Stewart K.

quotes.quote: It’s immersive, interactive , inspiring , thoughtful . Many near tear moments listening to such inspiring words from an inspiring man.
quotes.author: Nicole A.

quotes.quote: The Library is a Great addition to the presentation of US history and a statement that in effect explains TRs presence on Mt. Rushmore.
quotes.author: Lynn S.

quotes.quote: The displays are engaging, thought provoking, educational and fun.
quotes.author: Susanna C.
